verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams provides an admin panel where organizations provision access for team members and guests. Provisioned Team Computers can be assigned to a single member or to a group, and admins get role-based admin roles, so machines and users are organized centrally with group-based access. The documentation only covers machine-to-group assignment, not configurable per-group access policies, and nothing describes a shared address book view. missing for 10: explicit per-group policy settings (permissions or restrictions applied per group), documentation of a shared machine/user address book or console view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Organizations can provision access to guests and team members via the admin panel or by SSO
Once a Team Computer is provisioned, it can be assigned to either a single team member or a group.
Create granular admin roles through role based access
